propositions: Two decomposition-shape smells (layer-cake architectural partitioning and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge) are not detected by existing container criteria G3/G4 and require a new focused criterion.

A new advisory, agent-tier, container-scoped criterion 'decomp-shape' must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA, and routed with facet 'container' and default posture 'advisory'.
The criterion integrates into the pass1_container loop via the existing criterion fan-out seam without requiring new passes or engine constructs.
E6 judge order-sensitivity (fleiss_kappa=0.55 < 0.6 floor) is a prerequisite gate deferring blocking-promotion; advisory shipping is unaffected and safe under judge instability.
Eval_solver must be extended to run container criteria over fixtures with a children: list via pass1_container, keeping the sanity arm bounded to one live container call per fixture.

Bounded sanity with hand-authored fixtures (2 positive: layer-cake and consumed-artifact; 2 negative: vertical-slice and ordered producer/consumer) must achieve recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives.
